result.summary: The image depicts a residential row-house street with a continuous sidewalk but a total absence of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. While the street appears to have low traffic volume, the lack of marked crossings and curb ramps creates barriers for safe and accessible movement.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross in unmarked areas without priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire visible roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb line block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children, who might step into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right-hand curb line

hazards.name: Inaccessible sidewalk interface
hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps makes the transition from sidewalk to street difficult for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: At the curb edge throughout the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at intersections to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to reduce crossing distance and prevent parking too close to intersections, improving visibility.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install sloped ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure universal accessibility.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and marked crosswalks exist, the markings are faded and sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles and corner vegetation.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse lines of the crosswalk are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street in the foreground.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars near the corner and tall bushes on the corner property limit the ability of pedestrians and drivers to see each other.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection and the corner property on the left.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental-style high-visibility markings.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and prevent illegal parking too close to the crosswalk.
